statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in os.Root on Windows (directory junctions). It is compiled only into Windows binaries; these images hold linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 binaries.

The flaw is in the HTTP/2 server of golang.org/x/net/http2 (serverConn). The linux/amd64 binaries of kubectl 1.37.1, helm 4.3.0, gh 2.102.0, cosign 3.1.3, crane 0.22.1, and yq 4.54.1 do not contain golang.org/x/net/http2.(*serverConn): the linker left the server out.

The flaw is in net/http's HTTP/2 server flow control. net/http serves HTTP/2 only over TLS (ServeTLS, ListenAndServeTLS, or a TLS listener offering h2) or when unencrypted HTTP/2 is enabled. None of the packages kubectl 1.37.1, helm 4.3.0, gh 2.102.0, cosign 3.1.3, crane 0.22.1, or yq 4.54.1 compile does any of that; kubectl's only server, kubectl proxy, serves plain HTTP/1.1. The server code is linked but never runs. Superseded when these tools ship builds with Go 1.26.9 or 1.27.2: those versions don't match these statements, so the gate checks them again.
